extracted.name: Roasted Chicken Rub
extracted.description: This roast chicken seasoning is a herb and spice blend of paprika, garlic powder, thyme, rosemary, and sage — the perfect rub for whole chicken.
instruction_lines: Stir celery flakes, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, sage, black pepper, rosemary, and cayenne pepper together in a bowl.
Transfer spice mixture to a spice grinder or food processor; blend until smooth.
